message.content:
Based on my search, here are the typical jersey numbers for linebackers in football:

## NFL Linebacker Numbers

Under current NFL rules (as of 2021-2023), linebackers can wear numbers in the range of **0–59 and 90–99**.

This represents a significant expansion from previous rules:
- **Before 2021**: Linebackers were restricted to **40–59 and 90–99**
- **Before 2015**: Linebackers were limited to **50–59 and 90–99**
- **Before 1984**: Linebackers could only wear **50–59**

The 2021 rule change, proposed by the Kansas City Chiefs, gave linebackers access to single-digit numbers (0–9) and the 10–39 range, providing much more flexibility. The 2023 change added number 0 as an option.

## Traditional/Historical Linebacker Numbers

While the rules now allow more flexibility, traditionally linebackers have been most commonly associated with:
- **50–59**: The classic linebacker range (especially 50–59)
- **90–99**: Alternative range, particularly for outside linebackers and edge rushers

## College Football

College football has much less restrictive numbering rules. Players can generally wear any number from 0–99, with the only major requirement being that at least five offensive linemen must wear 50–79. This means linebackers in college often wear a wide variety of numbers, including many in the 40s and single digits.

## Examples

- **Brian Bosworth**: Wore #44 at Oklahoma (college), though he couldn't wear it in the NFL under old rules
- **Devin White**: Wore #40 at LSU
- **Leroy Hill**: Wore #48 for the Seattle Seahawks
- **C.J. Mosley**: Wears #57 for the Baltimore Ravens
- **Deontae Lawson**: Wears #0 at Alabama

Sources:
1. https://operations.nfl.com/the-rules/rules-changes/nfl-jersey-numbers/
2. https://touchdowntrips.com/nfl-jersey-numbers-explained/
3. https://www.jt-sw.com/football/pro/index.nsf/Documents/0-jers-nums
4. https://www.metroleague.org/nfl-jersey-numbers-list_af/
5. https://www.si.com/college/alabama/football/alabama-football-reveals-updated-jersey-numbers
6. https://sports.yahoo.com/3-broncos-players-change-jersey-123012151.html
7. https://lsureveille.com/159696/sports/linebacker-legacy-the-history-of-lsu-footballs-no-40-jersey/
8. https://www.baldwincountyschoolsga.org/post/bhs-retires-the-jersey-number-of-baldwin-brave-alumni-and-seattle-seahawks-linebacker-leroy-hill
